sentences.text: The applicant has filed this first application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

T he applicant has been arrested on 20.09.2022 by Police Station Civil Lines, District Morena(M.P.)
in connection with Crime No. 835/2022 registered fo r the offence punishable under Sections 363,
366, 376, 376-D, 376(2)(N), 120-B, 368, 366-A and 201 of IPC & Sections 3/4, 5/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(V), 3(1)(W-1) of SC/ST Act.
Allegation against the present applicant-accused is that he alongwith co- accused persons abducted prosecutrix A, B and C and committed rape upon them.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
The applicant is in custody since 20.09.2022.

The entire prosecution story is suspicious Hanumant Singh Gurjar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170430044/
1 because allegedly, for the first time, accused persons committed offence on 13.07.2022, however, no complaint or FIR was lodged by any prosecutrix.

sentences.text: After a delay of almost 2 months, an FIR was lodged on 13.09.2022, alleging the sexual assault on them on 13.09.2022, however, as per the MLC which was done on 14.09.2022, no external injuries were found on the body of all three prosecutrix.
There is also variation and material contradiction in respect to date and duration of sexual assault on them in MLC.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed, therefore, custodial interrogation is no more required.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents and he is permanent resident of District Morena (M.P.).
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no likelihood of his absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the present applicant.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
